description: This file contains the implementation of a global tracer provider for OpenTelemetry in Go, including forwarding, delegation, and no-op span handling.

classes.name: tracerProvider
classes.description: A placeholder for a configured SDK TracerProvider that forwards functionality or delegates to an actual provider.

classes.name: tracer
classes.description: A placeholder for a trace.Tracer that forwards calls or acts as a no-op.

classes.name: nonRecordingSpan
classes.description: A minimal implementation of a Span that wraps a SpanContext, performing no operations.

methods.name: setDelegate
methods.description: Configures the tracerProvider or tracer to delegate functionality to another provider.

methods.name: Tracer
methods.description: Returns a tracer instance, either delegated or a new no-op tracer.

methods.name: setDelegate
methods.description: Configures the tracer to delegate all span creation to a provider.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts a new span, forwarding to delegate if available, otherwise creating a non-recording span.

methods.name: IsRecording
methods.description: Indicates if the span is recording; always false for nonRecordingSpan.

methods.name: SetStatus
methods.description: No-op method for setting span status.

methods.name: SetError
methods.description: No-op method for setting span error.

methods.name: SetAttributes
methods.description: No-op method for setting span attributes.

methods.name: End
methods.description: No-op method for ending a span.

methods.name: RecordError
methods.description: No-op method for recording an error.

methods.name: AddEvent
methods.description: No-op method for adding an event.

methods.name: AddLink
methods.description: No-op method for adding a link.

methods.name: SetName
methods.description: No-op method for setting span name.

methods.name: TracerProvider
methods.description: Returns the tracer provider associated with the span.
